name: Form Orah – Contact Form Builder & Lead Intelligence
author: kevin10676

sections.description:
Form Orah is a powerful contact form builder that goes far beyond basic contact forms. Connect your WordPress site to your Form Orah account and embed smart, conversion-optimized contact forms anywhere — in seconds.

Every contact form submission is automatically AI-scored (HOT / WARM / COLD), followed up with a personalized email, and tracked in a full lead intelligence dashboard.

What Form Orah does

Form Orah turns your contact forms into a lead engine:

  • AI lead scoring — every contact form submission is scored and qualified automatically
  • E-signatures — let contacts sign documents directly inside your contact form
  • Multi-step contact forms — break long forms into conversational steps that convert better
  • Conditional logic — show or hide fields based on previous answers
  • Real-time analytics — see which contact forms convert and why
  • Automated follow-up emails — personalized emails sent the moment a form is submitted
  • Gutenberg block — visual contact form picker with live preview in the editor
  • Shortcode support — works with Elementor, Divi, and any page builder

What is Form Orah?

Form Orah is an AI-powered contact form and lead capture platform. Build any type of contact form — simple inquiry forms, multi-step lead gen forms, quote request forms, appointment booking forms, and more — then embed them on your WordPress site in one click.

Sign up free at formorah.com — the free plan includes unlimited contact forms and submissions.

Features in this plugin

  • Gutenberg block — add a Form Orah contact form to any page with a visual picker
  • [forc_form] shortcode — paste your contact form into any editor, widget, or page builder
  • Dashboard widget — see your 10 most recent contact form leads with AI scores, without leaving WordPress
  • Settings page — enter your API key, test the connection, and manage your contact form configuration

Usage

  1. Install and activate the plugin
  2. Go to Form Orah → Settings and paste your API key (get it from app.formorah.com/settings/developer)
  3. Click Test Connection to verify, then Save
  4. Edit any page or post, add the Form Orah block, and pick your contact form

Or use the shortcode anywhere:

[forc_form id="your-form-id"]

You can find your form ID in the Form Orah builder URL.

External Services

This plugin connects to the Form Orah API (https://app.formorah.com) to:

  • Retrieve the list of forms associated with your account
  • Retrieve recent form submissions for the WordPress dashboard widget
  • Test your API key connection

Data sent to the Form Orah API includes your API key (transmitted as a Bearer token in the Authorization header). No visitor data is collected or transmitted by this plugin — the embedded form runs inside an iframe served directly by Form Orah.

The Form Orah service is operated by Pure Grace AI, LLC.

  • Privacy Policy
  • Terms of Service

This plugin only contacts the Form Orah API when an administrator has entered a valid API key in the plugin settings.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the form-orah-contact-form-builder-lead-intelligence folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Go to Form Orah → Settings to enter your API key

Or install directly from the WordPress Plugin Directory: Plugins → Add New → search “Form Orah contact form”.
sections.faq:
Do I need a Form Orah account to use this contact form plugin?

Yes. Sign up free at formorah.com — the free plan includes unlimited contact forms and submissions with no time limit.

Where do I find my API key?

Log in to app.formorah.com, go to Settings → Developer, and create a new API key. Copy it and paste it into the plugin settings.

What does Form Orah add to a contact form?

Form Orah scores every submission with AI (HOT / WARM / COLD), sends personalized follow-up emails automatically, and gives you a full lead intelligence dashboard.

Does the plugin work with the classic editor?

Yes — use the [forc_form id="your-form-id"] shortcode in any editor, widget, or page builder.

Does this contact form plugin work with Elementor, Divi, or other page builders?

Yes — use the shortcode widget in any page builder that supports shortcodes, including Elementor, Divi, Beaver Builder, WPBakery, and Bricks.

Can I add multiple contact forms to one page?

Yes — add as many [forc_form id="..."] shortcodes or blocks as you need. Each one loads independently.

Will this slow down my WordPress site?

No. Contact form data is fetched via the Form Orah API and cached for 5 minutes. The embedded contact form loads asynchronously and never blocks your page render.

Can my contact forms collect e-signatures?

Yes — Form Orah supports e-signature steps inside contact forms. Signers receive a signed PDF with a certificate and audit trail.
